name: Stickman Army: The Resistance 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Stickman Army: The Resistance is a cool fighting defense game in which you must control two stickmen soldiers and try to survive for as long as possible. Each stickman character covers one side of their defensive tower and you must switch between both defenders to prevent your position from being overrun.
